text.full_range: Next set: all the way up, all the way down
tips: Tip: keep your elbows pinned to your sides
Tip: no swinging, keep your back still
Tip: squeeze at the top, lower slowly

text.full_range: Next set: lift to shoulder height every rep
tips: Tip: lead with your elbows, not your hands
Tip: keep a slight bend in your elbows

text.full_range: Next set: arms straight at the top, every rep
tips: Tip: brace your core, don't arch your back
Tip: press straight up, biceps by your ears
Tip: lower to chin height, no lower

text.full_range: Next set: thighs to parallel, every rep
text.form_advice: Next set: chest up, back straight
tips: Tip: push your knees out over your toes
Tip: keep your heels on the floor
Tip: brace your core before you go down

text.full_range: Next set: chest to the floor, every rep
text.form: Keep your body in a straight line
text.form_advice: Next set: squeeze your glutes, body straight
tips: Tip: elbows at 45°, not flared out
Tip: squeeze your glutes the whole set
Tip: chest to the floor, then lock out
